payload.title: Probing Deep Into Temporal Profile Makes the Infrared Small Target Detector Much Better
payload.publisher_access: DOI resolves to publisher; direct article text failed SSL. Publication crosschecked via author and bibliographic sources.
payload.paper_version: v5 2026-03-27; latest author manuscript; v2 failure wording crosschecked remains in v5
payload.code_status: Actual source and train/test scripts present; no execution test performed

weights.status: Actual checkpoint HTTP 200 verified without loading/executing
weights.other_weights: DeepPro-Plus NUDT, HiNo, RGBT, SatVideo also present in Git tree

payload.native_task: Multiframe dense binary segmentation/confidence map for all T frames, not native bounding-box detector. RGBT-Tiny has box labels and requires special evaluation rules.
payload.mechanism: Default 40-frame clips. TPro applies learned full T-by-T mixing to temporal profiles at fixed spatial locations; no recurrent state across clips. Inference windows overlap 10% and repeated frame outputs are unioned. Full-window temporal mixing is acausal by inspection.

own_verified_failures.failure: Pedestrian partly obscured by trees is missed; incomplete temporal signal becomes a narrow spike. Authors give two possible reasons: incomplete signal and missing such training examples.
own_verified_failures.status: Reported own failure; causal attribution not established

own_verified_failures.failure: Three temporarily stationary pedestrians are missed. Fixed spatial temporal profile stays near a plateau for over 40 frames.
own_verified_failures.status: Reported own failure; image-coordinate residence/static appearance, not proof about arbitrary world-stationary objects

own_verified_failures.source_section: IV-C2 Table V and Appendix E-C1/F
own_verified_failures.failure: Longer contiguous windows have limited benefit: DeepPro T40 Pd59.17/Fa1.76 vs T80 Pd60.21/Fa3.61 (Fa units 1e-5) on HiNo. Authors explicitly discuss extracting useful longer history as future work.
own_verified_failures.status: Measured tradeoff on this dataset only; does not establish mechanism generality

payload.existing_obvious_extensions: DeepPro+S and DeepPro-Plus already add spatial computations; Plus theoretical spatial RF19x19 and STD residual blocks. Simply adding a spatial branch is not a defensible novelty claim.
payload.figure_observation: Fig17 viewed: stationary m2-m4 remain visually visible in magnified spatial crops; this is visual inspection only and does not prove a single-frame model recovers them. Paper does not explicitly assign Fig17 to base versus Plus in the caption, although preceding real-world experiment uses Plus.

candidate_improvement.problem: Preserve detection evidence across motion-to-dwell transitions that outlast a fixed 40-frame clip, while correctly deleting stale evidence after a target leaves.
candidate_improvement.minimal_method: Use DeepPro-Plus as encoder; maintain sparse target evidence states seeded by a valid motion event. Retrieve last reliable target event and pre-arrival local background, compare current local appearance to both, and update a survival/exit decision. Store event evidence rather than blindly enlarging a contiguous dense time window.
must_beat: augmentation-only with stop/restart and partial occlusion
TDCNet AAAI2026 stationary/extremely-slow strong control; match data and evaluation task before comparing
metrics: time to reacquire after visible return
false persistence duration after true exit
event-conditioned recall at fixed false events per minute
first detection latency with equal future-frame budget

boundaries: No claim that all IRSTD benchmarks are saturated.
No claim that CHAL or HomoDiff share these failures without testing.
Occlusion hypothesis separate from stationary failure; do not assume absent target can be detected from no observations.
RGBT-Tiny failure cases are pedestrians, not proof of identical failure for 1-3 pixel aerial targets.
Novelty relative to general tracking and static/dynamic background models unresolved.
README includes stale under-peer-review sentence; author homepage and formal issue metadata confirm published status.

Parent parallel evidence: TDCNet AAAI2026 supplement §5.3 reports AP50=96.27 on 250 stationary/extremely slow frames. This disproves a field-wide inability claim. TDCNet must be a strong control; attach the parent verified source in final synthesis.
Stationary misses are source-verified; stop-to-dwell transition continuous miss duration is a proposed evaluation and has not been measured or reported in this source.

payload.title: Spatio-Temporal Context Learning with Temporal Difference Convolution for Moving Infrared Small Target Detection
payload.status: published proceedings; official AAAI PDF and author code verified
payload.data_weights: Author README links Google Drive and Baidu Netdisk for weights and IRSTD-UAV; links seen, downloads not tested
payload.data: IRSTD-UAV: 17 real video sequences, 15106 frames; IRDST: real videos

evidence.interpretation: Measured loss as frames become more separated. Cannot isolate egomotion: target displacement and temporal horizon change too.

evidence.fact: IRSTD-UAV divides each sequence into 50-frame segments, shuffles and splits 8:2. This is not a held-out-video evaluation; no empirical inflation claim is made.
Released recipe instructs background alignment before train/test with GIM and background_alignment.py.
Static/very slow test exists: 5 sequences ×50 frames; AP50 96.27, recall97.20. Thus do not claim static targets were ignored.

payload.measured_metrics: P/R/F1/AP50 at box IoU0.5; FPS/parameters/FLOPs; temporal-length, slow/static, and frame-interval ablations
payload.not_measured_in_read_sections: Consecutive miss duration, recovery after corrupted support frames, time to first reliable detection, controlled separation of camera and target motion, held-out-scene generalization for IRSTD-UAV
payload.remaining_problem: After increased temporal separation, detection loses recall despite high ordinary-set scores; identify which support correspondence failures generate sustained missed detections, then remedy them.

payload.title: MIST: A Benchmark and Baseline for Multi-frame Infrared Small Target Detection in Complex Motion
payload.venue: IEEE Transactions on Image Processing 2026, vol35 pp5196–5211
payload.status: Author README records TIP acceptance 2026-04-27; bibliographic record confirms publication
payload.data_weights: Official README links MIST data and pretrained model weights on Google Drive; downloads not tested
payload.data: Targets generated by synthetic engine and blended into real backgrounds; 78 train/42 test sequences, 11-sequence MIST-Hard; not fully real captured target videos

evidence.fact: MIST-Hard combines SCR<=1, highly irregular trajectories, and speeds>7pixels/frame.

evidence.location: Official benchmark TableII image, visually read
evidence.interpretation: Hard subset is measurably harder even for proposed baseline; cross-column comparisons are not a train-on-one/test-on-another transfer experiment.

payload.not_measured_or_not_verified: Full article inaccessible in bounded search; no claims about absent full-paper evaluations. README/table do not establish recovery behavior or isolated abrupt-motion cause. Hard subset changes contrast and motion together.
payload.remaining_problem: Complex-motion/low-contrast sequences remain less reliable; usable controlled data and released model support diagnostic screening, but real-sequence corroboration is required.

payload.title: Rethinking Evaluation of Infrared Small Target Detection
payload.status: Author arXiv comments and official NeurIPS-hosted slides verified; proceedings landing page not retrieved in bounded search

evidence.fact: Separates target localization and segmentation with hIoU/error taxonomy; cross-dataset evaluation. Main evaluation concentrates on single-frame segmentation methods.
Explicitly evaluates three multi-frame methods; hIoU 0.552/0.546/0.591, target localization IoU 0.683/0.669/0.719. These are not evidence about CHAL/TDCNet failures.

payload.measured_metrics: Mask matching, localization/segmentation errors and cross-dataset transfer; multi-frame aggregate extension
payload.what_metrics_conceal: Inference from metric definitions: framewise pooled scores are unchanged if identical per-frame errors are reordered, hence cannot distinguish isolated misses from one long blind interval. Paper does not itself demonstrate temporal burst failures.
payload.remaining_problem: Reuse established spatial error taxonomy and add event-aligned sequence diagnosis rather than claim a new generic metric.

scope: Canonical-ID union of four extracted papers; no local model evaluation
